title: Marketing plan for app launch
title_vi: Kế hoạch marketing ra mắt ứng dụng
lines: Okay, let's touch base on the launch of the SmartDesk app. It goes live on March 3rd, so we've got about five weeks.
Right. I think we should start with social media ads. They worked really well for our last product.
I agree, Priya. But I'd also like to send an email to our existing customers. We have about twenty thousand on the list.
Good idea, Ethan. Who can write the email?
I can draft it this week, and the design team can add some images.
What about a launch video? Customers love short demos.
Sounds great, but the video agency needs at least three weeks, so we'd have to book them by Friday.
No problem. I'll call the agency this afternoon and get a quote.
Perfect. Let's meet again next Monday to make sure we're on track.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
o: Ways to promote a new app
questions.vi: Câu mở đầu "let's touch base on the launch of the SmartDesk app" và cả bài bàn về quảng cáo, email, video → quảng bá ứng dụng mới. Ngày ra mắt (March 3rd) đã được chốt nên "Choosing a launch date" là bẫy.

questions.q: According to Ethan, how many customers are on the email list?
questions.vi: Ethan nói "We have about twenty thousand on the list". Bẫy: "five weeks" và "three weeks" là số khác trong bài.

questions.q: What does Ethan offer to do?
questions.vi: "I can draft it this week" – draft = viết bản nháp email. Việc thêm hình là của design team, không phải Ethan.

questions.q: What will Priya probably do this afternoon?
o: Ask an agency for a price
questions.vi: Priya nói "I'll call the agency this afternoon and get a quote" – quote = báo giá, được diễn đạt lại thành "ask for a price". Cuộc họp là "next Monday".

title: Q4 budget cut
lines: Thanks for joining. I'm afraid I've got some bad news. The Q4 budget for the CRM upgrade has been cut by fifteen percent.
Fifteen? Ouch. We were already running tight. What's driving that, Hannah?
Sales came in below forecast in Q3, so every department has to tighten its belt.
Well, Carlos, we could postpone the mobile app integration. The sales team won't really use it until spring anyway.
True, Mei, and that's where most of the licensing cost sits. What about the data migration?
We can't drop that. The old system's support contract ends on December 31st.
Then the mobile piece is the obvious candidate. How much would that save?
Roughly forty thousand dollars, which more than covers the cut.
Great. Can you put that in writing so I can take it to the finance director on Thursday?
Sure, I'll send you a revised plan first thing tomorrow.

questions.q: What does Carlos mean when he says, "We were already running tight"?
o: The project had little money to spare
questions.vi: "Running tight" ở đây nói về ngân sách: vốn đã eo hẹp, giờ còn bị cắt 15%. Bẫy: hiểu "tight" là lịch trình/giờ làm.

questions.q: Why was the budget reduced?
questions.vi: Hannah: "Sales came in below forecast in Q3" → doanh số thấp hơn dự báo. "Support contract ends" là lý do không thể bỏ data migration, không phải lý do cắt ngân sách.

questions.q: How much would postponing the mobile integration save?
questions.vi: Carlos: "Roughly forty thousand dollars". Bẫy: "fifteen percent" và "December 31st".

questions.q: What does Carlos say he will do?
o: Meet the finance director on Thursday
questions.vi: "I'll send you a revised plan first thing tomorrow" – revised = updated. Gặp finance director vào thứ Năm là việc của Hannah.

title: Damaged delivery
lines: Thanks for calling Brightline Home Goods, this is Sara. How can I help?
Hi, my name's Liam Doyle. I ordered a glass dining table, and it arrived this morning with a crack right across the top.
Oh, I'm so sorry to hear that. Was the box itself damaged when it was delivered?
Yeah, one corner was crushed. Luckily, I took photos before I opened it.
That's really helpful. If you email those to us, I can file a claim with the courier today.
Fine, but I've got eight people coming for dinner on the twentieth. I can't exactly wait three weeks for a replacement.
Understood. Normally replacements take ten business days, but our Leeds warehouse has that model in stock, so I can send one by express. It'd reach you on the eighteenth.
That's cutting it close, but it works. And what about the broken one?
Our driver will collect it when he drops off the new table, so there's nothing you need to do.
Great. Where should I send the photos?
I'll text you a link right after this call.

questions.q: Why is the man calling?
o: His order has not been delivered
A product he bought arrived broken
He wants to cancel a dinner booking
He was charged the wrong amount
questions.vi: "it arrived this morning with a crack right across the top" → hàng đến bị nứt. Bẫy: "dinner" có trong bài nhưng là bữa tối ở nhà anh ấy.

questions.q: What does the man imply when he says, "I can't exactly wait three weeks for a replacement"?
o: He needs the item before an event
He would prefer a full refund
He was promised delivery in three weeks
He will buy from another store
questions.vi: Ngay trước đó anh nói có 8 khách ăn tối ngày 20 → cần bàn trước sự kiện. Bẫy: "three weeks" không phải là thời hạn được hứa.

questions.q: When will the replacement most likely arrive?
questions.vi: "It'd reach you on the eighteenth" (gửi express). Bẫy: "twentieth" là ngày bữa tối, "ten business days" là thời gian bình thường.

questions.q: What will the woman do after the call?
o: Text the man a way to send pictures
questions.vi: Liam hỏi gửi ảnh ở đâu, Sara trả lời "I'll text you a link right after this call". Gửi ảnh qua email là việc của người đàn ông.

title: Weekend database migration
title_vi: Di chuyển cơ sở dữ liệu cuối tuần
lines: Lisa, have you got a minute? I want to plan the database migration.
Sure, James. Are we still doing it this weekend?
Yes, on Saturday night. We'll start at 10 p.m., when traffic is lowest.
About six hours, if everything goes well. So we should finish by 4 a.m., well before anyone logs in on Sunday morning.
OK. Who's going to be on call?
I'll take Saturday night, and Raj will cover Sunday in case anything breaks.
I can be the backup on Saturday. I'll keep my phone on, so just call me if you need help. Do we have a rollback plan, too?

Yes, I wrote one last week. If something goes wrong, we can switch back to the old server in about thirty minutes. Oh, and could you give the customer support team a heads-up? They should know the system will be down.
No problem. I'll email them this afternoon.

questions.q: What are the speakers planning?
o: Moving a database over the weekend
questions.vi: "I want to plan the database migration" ... "this weekend" → chuyển cơ sở dữ liệu cuối tuần.

questions.q: What time will the work start?
questions.vi: "We'll start at 10 p.m." Bẫy: "4 a.m." là giờ kết thúc, "six hours" là thời lượng.

questions.q: Who will be on call on Sunday?
questions.vi: "Raj will cover Sunday". James trực tối thứ Bảy, Lisa là người dự phòng thứ Bảy.

questions.q: What will the woman probably do this afternoon?
questions.vi: James nhờ báo support team rằng hệ thống sẽ ngừng ("will be down"); Lisa: "I'll email them this afternoon".

title: Signing up for training
title_vi: Đăng ký khóa đào tạo nội bộ
lines: Hi Grace, I'd like to sign up for the project management course next month. Are there any seats left?
Let me check. The session on the 12th and 13th is fully booked, I'm afraid.
Oh, that's a shame. Is there another one?
There's a second session on the 26th and 27th. It has four seats left.
That should work. I'll need my manager's approval first, though, right?
Yes, she has to sign off on it. But I can hold a seat for you until Friday.
Perfect. I'll talk to her this afternoon.
Great. And just so you know, the course is in the Riverside building, not here at head office.
Riverside? That's a bit of a trek from my place.
It is, but there's a shuttle bus from the main entrance every thirty minutes.

questions.q: What does the man want to do?
questions.vi: "I'd like to sign up for the project management course" – sign up = enroll, course = training program.

questions.q: When does the available session begin?
questions.vi: Khóa 12–13 đã "fully booked"; khóa còn chỗ là "the 26th and 27th". Bẫy: "Friday" là hạn giữ chỗ.

questions.q: What does the woman offer to do?
o: Reserve a place for a few days
questions.vi: "I can hold a seat for you until Friday" – hold a seat = giữ chỗ. Việc duyệt (sign off) là của quản lý.

questions.q: What does the man mean when he says, "That's a bit of a trek from my place"?
o: He prefers to work from home
He will be late for the course
The location is far for him
questions.vi: "A trek" = một quãng đường dài, vất vả → địa điểm xa nhà anh. Grace đáp lại bằng thông tin xe đưa đón, xác nhận ý này.

title: Contract renewal on hold
title_vi: Gia hạn hợp đồng chờ pháp chế
lines: Olivia, quick question. Where are we with the Harlow Logistics renewal? Their current contract runs out on the 30th.
I know, Kevin. I'm about two-thirds of the way through it, but there's a new liability clause in section 9 that I'm not comfortable with.
It caps their liability at fifty thousand, down from two hundred thousand in the old agreement. That shifts a lot of risk onto us.
Hmm. Their account manager didn't mention that at all.
They often don't. I'd like to push back before we sign anything.
Fair enough, but if this slips past the 30th, we lose the discounted rate they offered.
Then let's ask for a short extension. Could you get them to keep the old terms in place until mid-month?
I'll ring them this afternoon. Should I loop you in on the call?
Please do. It'll be quicker if I explain the clause myself.

questions.q: Why has the contract renewal been delayed?
o: The supplier hasn't sent the contract
A term in the new draft is a concern
questions.vi: Olivia: "there's a new liability clause in section 9 that I'm not comfortable with" – clause = term. Bẫy: ưu đãi chỉ mất NẾU trễ quá ngày 30, chưa hết hạn.

questions.q: What is the liability limit in the new agreement?
questions.vi: "It caps their liability at fifty thousand, down from two hundred thousand". Bẫy: 200.000 là mức cũ; "30th" và "section 9" là số khác.

questions.q: According to the man, what will happen if the deadline is missed?
o: A lower price will no longer be available
The old terms will stay in place
The liability cap will be raised
questions.vi: "we lose the discounted rate they offered" → mất giá ưu đãi. "Keep the old terms" là điều họ định đề nghị, không phải hậu quả.

questions.q: What will the man probably do this afternoon?
o: Ask the other company for more time
questions.vi: Olivia đề nghị xin gia hạn ngắn ("ask for a short extension"), Kevin: "I'll ring them this afternoon". Đọc section 9 là việc của Olivia.

title: Company hackathon
lines: So, the hackathon is on November 28th. Josh, did you find a venue?
Yeah. The big conference room on the fifth floor is too small, so I booked the event space at the Lakeside Hotel. It holds a hundred and fifty people.
Great. How many people have signed up so far, Sam?
Eighty-four, and registration closes next Friday. Most people want to work in teams of four.
Teams of four sounds good. What about prizes?
Management approved three thousand dollars. Maybe two thousand for first place and a thousand for second?
Hmm, that's a bit much for one team. Why not split it into three prizes?
Good point. Let's do fifteen hundred, one thousand, and five hundred.
Sounds fair. I'll update the event page today.
Thanks, Sam. And Josh, could you sort out food for the day?
Sure, I'll get some quotes from caterers.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
o: A client conference at a hotel
questions.vi: Cả bài bàn về địa điểm, số người, giải thưởng, đồ ăn cho "the hackathon" → sự kiện công ty. Bẫy: "hotel" có trong bài nhưng không phải hội nghị khách hàng.

questions.q: Where will the hackathon take place?
questions.vi: "I booked the event space at the Lakeside Hotel". Phòng họp tầng 5 "too small" nên bị loại.

questions.q: What does Josh mean when he says, "that's a bit much for one team"?
questions.vi: Josh phản hồi đề xuất $2.000 cho giải nhất và gợi ý chia thành 3 giải → giải đó quá lớn cho một đội.

questions.q: What will Josh probably do next?
questions.vi: "I'll get some quotes from caterers". Cập nhật trang sự kiện là việc của Sam.

title: Hybrid work policy questions
title_vi: Hỏi về chính sách làm việc kết hợp
lines: Hi Chloe, got a sec? I've got a couple of questions about the new hybrid work policy.
Sure, Mark. What do you want to know?
The email said three days a week in the office. Can I choose which days?
Mostly, yes. But everyone has to be in on Tuesdays for team meetings. You pick the other two.
OK. And when does it actually start? I thought it was this month.
It was supposed to, but the new desk booking system isn't ready yet, so it's been pushed to January 6th.
Got it. What if I need to work from home on a Tuesday, say, for a delivery?
Just get your manager's OK at least a day in advance. It's fine once in a while.
Makes sense. Is there a document with all of this?
There's an FAQ on the intranet. I'll send you the link after lunch.

questions.q: On which day must all employees be in the office?
questions.vi: "everyone has to be in on Tuesdays for team meetings". Hai ngày còn lại mới được tự chọn.

questions.q: Why has the start of the policy been delayed?
questions.vi: "the new desk booking system isn't ready yet" – booking system = reservation system.

questions.q: What must employees do to work from home on a Tuesday?
questions.vi: "get your manager's OK at least a day in advance" → xin phép trước một ngày. Bẫy: "desk booking" có trong bài nhưng nói về chuyện khác.

questions.q: What does the woman offer to do?
o: Share a link to a document
Book a desk for the man
questions.vi: "I'll send you the link after lunch" (link tới FAQ trên intranet).

title: Client feedback on mockups
title_vi: Phản hồi của khách về bản thiết kế
lines: Ryan, I just got off a call with Northwind about the mockups. Overall they're happy, but they've flagged a few things.
First, the colour scheme. They think the dark blue feels a bit too corporate for a fitness app.
Fair enough. I can try something brighter. Anything else?
The checkout flow. They'd like it cut from five screens to three.
Three? That's doable, but I'd need to rethink the payment step entirely.
I figured. They originally wanted the revision by Wednesday, but I told them Friday was more realistic.
Friday the 14th? Honestly, given the checkout changes, Monday the 17th would be safer.
Hmm, I've already committed to Friday. Could you send the new colours by Wednesday and the checkout by Friday?
OK, that I can manage. I'll share a draft palette with you tomorrow so you can check it first.

questions.q: What is the conversation mainly about?
o: A problem with a payment system
questions.vi: "they've flagged a few things" rồi liệt kê màu sắc và checkout → yêu cầu chỉnh sửa của khách. Bẫy: "payment step" có trong bài nhưng không phải sự cố.

questions.q: How many screens does the client want in the checkout flow?
questions.vi: "cut from five screens to three". Bẫy: 5 là số hiện tại; 14 và 17 là ngày tháng.

questions.q: What does the woman imply when she says, "I've already committed to Friday"?
o: She doesn't want to change the deadline
questions.vi: Ryan đề nghị dời sang thứ Hai 17; Emma đáp đã hứa với khách thứ Sáu → không muốn đổi hạn.

questions.q: What does the woman ask the man to do?
o: Deliver the work in two stages
questions.vi: "send the new colours by Wednesday and the checkout by Friday" → nộp thành hai phần. Bẫy: ngày 17 là đề xuất của Ryan và bị từ chối.

title: Client dinner reservation
lines: Good afternoon, Rosa's Kitchen. How can I help you?
Hi, I'd like to book a table for a client dinner this Thursday, please.
Of course. For how many people?
Six. Around seven o'clock, if possible.
Let me see. Seven is fully booked, but I can offer you seven thirty.
Seven thirty is fine. Do you have a private room? We'll be talking business.
Yes, we do. There's a small room upstairs that seats eight. There's a fifty-dollar booking fee for it, though.
That's OK. Oh, and one of our guests is vegetarian.
No problem. Our chef has a full vegetarian menu. Could I have a name and phone number for the booking?
Sure. It's Ben Carter, from Atlas Software. My number is 555-0142.
Thank you, Mr. Carter. I'll send you a confirmation text shortly.

questions.q: Why is the man calling?
o: To order food for an office
questions.vi: "I'd like to book a table for a client dinner" – book a table = make a reservation.

questions.q: What time will the dinner start?
questions.vi: 7 giờ đã kín chỗ; nhà hàng đề nghị "seven thirty" và anh đồng ý. Bẫy: "seven o'clock" là giờ anh muốn ban đầu; 6 và 8 là số người/số ghế.

questions.q: What does the man mention about one of the guests?
o: The guest works at Atlas Software
The guest does not eat meat
The guest needs a private room
questions.vi: "one of our guests is vegetarian" → không ăn thịt. Atlas Software là công ty của Ben.

questions.q: What will the woman do next?
questions.vi: "I'll send you a confirmation text shortly".

title: Stock shortage before big order
lines: Oliver, I need a quick update. Are we set for the Kenton order? They want twelve hundred units shipped by the 22nd.
Not quite, Dana. I ran the count this morning, and we've only got about nine hundred in stock.
Nine hundred? The system showed fifteen hundred last week.
I know. It turns out a batch of three hundred was damaged in the flood at the Dover site, and nobody updated the records.
That's not ideal. Can the factory make up the difference in time?
I called them. They can do it, but not until the 25th.
That's three days late. Kenton won't be happy.
What if we send the nine hundred on time and the rest as a second shipment? We'd cover the extra shipping cost.
That might fly. I'll run it by their buyer and get back to you by end of day.

questions.q: How many units are currently in stock?
questions.vi: "we've only got about nine hundred in stock". Bẫy: 1.200 là số khách đặt, 1.500 là số hệ thống hiển thị, 300 là lô bị hỏng.

questions.q: Why was the inventory record wrong?
o: Damaged goods were not removed from it
The factory sent too many units
questions.vi: "a batch of three hundred was damaged ... and nobody updated the records" → hàng hỏng chưa được trừ khỏi hệ thống.

questions.q: What does the woman mean when she says, "That might fly"?
o: The goods could be sent by air
questions.vi: "That might fly" = ý đó có thể được chấp nhận. Bẫy nghĩa đen "fly" = gửi bằng máy bay.

questions.q: What will the woman probably do next?
o: Discuss a plan with the customer
questions.vi: "I'll run it by their buyer" – run it by = hỏi ý kiến người mua của Kenton. Gọi nhà máy là việc Oliver đã làm.

title: Reporting a phishing email
lines: Hi, is this IT security? I think I may have received a phishing email.
You've come to the right place. What made you suspicious?
It looked like it came from our payroll provider, asking me to confirm my bank details by Friday or my salary would be delayed. But the sender's address ended in dot-co instead of dot-com.
Good catch. Did you click the link or download anything?
I clicked the link, but as soon as the login page came up, something felt off, so I closed it. I didn't type anything in.
OK, that's reassuring. Still, to be on the safe side, I'll need you to change your password within the next hour.
Sure. Should I delete the email?
Not yet. And please don't forward it. Use the 'Report phishing' button in Outlook instead. That sends us the full message headers.
Will do. Has anyone else gotten it?
You're the third person this morning, so I'll send a company-wide alert shortly.

questions.q: Why did the woman become suspicious of the email?
o: The sender's address looked slightly wrong
questions.vi: "the sender's address ended in dot-co instead of dot-com". Bẫy: "Friday" và "salary would be delayed" là nội dung đe dọa trong email, không phải lý do cô nghi ngờ.

questions.q: What does the woman say she did?
o: She opened a page but entered nothing
questions.vi: "I clicked the link ... so I closed it. I didn't type anything in." Cô hỏi có nên xóa nhưng chưa xóa.

questions.q: How soon must the woman change her password?
questions.vi: "change your password within the next hour" = trong 60 phút. Bẫy: "Friday" là hạn trong email lừa đảo, "third" là số người báo cáo.

questions.q: What will the man probably do next?
questions.vi: "I'll send a company-wide alert shortly" → cảnh báo toàn công ty. Đổi mật khẩu là việc người phụ nữ phải làm.

title: Report numbers don't match
title_vi: Số liệu báo cáo quý không khớp
lines: Paul, Zoe, thanks for coming. I found a problem in the quarterly report before it goes to the board.
The total revenue on page two says four point two million, but the table on page five says four point five million.
Oh no. I think I know why. The sales team sent us updated figures last Tuesday.
And only one page was updated?
Probably. I changed the table, but I may have missed the summary.
The four point five million. But I'll double-check with sales to be sure.
When does the report have to be ready?
The board meeting is on Thursday, so we need the final version by Wednesday at noon.
No sweat. I'll check the other pages for the same mistake.

questions.q: What problem does Karen mention?
o: A report was sent too late
A page is missing from the report
Two figures in a report are different
questions.vi: Trang 2 ghi 4,2 triệu nhưng bảng trang 5 ghi 4,5 triệu → hai con số không khớp.

questions.q: What does Zoe say she will do?
o: Present the report to the board
Confirm a figure with another team
questions.vi: "I'll double-check with sales to be sure". Kiểm tra các trang khác là việc của Paul.

questions.q: When is the final version due?
questions.vi: "we need the final version by Wednesday at noon". Bẫy: thứ Năm là ngày họp hội đồng, thứ Ba là ngày sales gửi số liệu.

questions.q: What does Paul mean when he says, "No sweat"?
o: He is not worried about the board
The task will be easy for him
questions.vi: "No sweat" = không vấn đề gì, dễ thôi; anh nhận kiểm tra các trang khác. Bẫy nghĩa đen "sweat" = mồ hôi.

title: Scheduling performance reviews
title_vi: Sắp xếp buổi đánh giá hiệu suất
lines: Hi Nathan, I need to set up performance reviews for my team. HR wants them done by the end of the month, right?
Actually, Sophie, the deadline's been brought forward to the 24th, because payroll needs the ratings for the January pay raises.
Oh, I hadn't heard that. That only gives me two weeks, and I've got seven people to see.
Each meeting should take about forty-five minutes. Want me to book them for you?
That'd be a huge help. Could you avoid Mondays? I'm in client meetings all day.
Sure. I'll spread them over Tuesday to Thursday. And remember, each person needs to submit a self-assessment beforehand.
In the HR portal, under 'Reviews'. I'll send everyone a reminder with the link.
Thanks. Oh, and can you book room 4B? It's quieter than the others.
I'll check if it's free and send you the calendar invites by tomorrow.

questions.q: When must the reviews be completed?
o: By the end of the month
questions.vi: "the deadline's been brought forward to the 24th". Bẫy: "end of the month" là hạn cũ Sophie tưởng; January là thời điểm tăng lương.

questions.q: Why was the deadline changed?
o: Pay decisions depend on the results
questions.vi: "payroll needs the ratings for the January pay raises" → kết quả đánh giá dùng để quyết định tăng lương.

questions.q: What does the man offer to do?
questions.vi: "Want me to book them for you?" – book = sắp lịch các buổi gặp.

questions.q: Why does the woman ask for room 4B?
questions.vi: "It's quieter than the others" = ít ồn hơn.

title: Trade show booth setup
title_vi: Chuẩn bị gian hàng hội chợ
lines: Amelia, the TechConnect conference is three weeks away. Where are we with the booth?
We've got space 214, right by the main entrance. It's smaller than last year's, three by three metres instead of three by six, but the foot traffic should be much better.
Good trade-off. What about the display screens?
The rental company quoted eighteen hundred for two screens, which is over budget. I'm waiting on a second quote that's due Wednesday.
That's the bottleneck. The printer needs final artwork ten days before the event, and marketing still hasn't signed off on the new logo.
Seriously? That's been on their desk for two weeks.
I know. I've chased them twice.
Let me have a word with Diane, their director. She owes me one.
That'd be great. If we can get approval by Friday, we're still on track.

questions.q: What does the woman say about the booth's location?
o: It is larger than last year's
It is far from the entrance
questions.vi: "the foot traffic should be much better" → nhiều khách đi qua hơn. Bẫy: gian hàng NHỎ hơn năm ngoái; 1.800 là giá thuê màn hình.

questions.q: Why might the banners be delayed?
o: The printer is ten days behind
A second quote is due Wednesday
A design has not been approved
questions.vi: "marketing still hasn't signed off on the new logo" → thiết kế chưa được duyệt. "ten days" là thời hạn của nhà in, không phải sự chậm trễ.

questions.q: What does the man offer to do?
questions.vi: "Let me have a word with Diane, their director" – director của marketing = trưởng bộ phận. Lấy báo giá thứ hai là việc Amelia đang chờ.

questions.q: By when is approval needed to stay on schedule?
questions.vi: "If we can get approval by Friday, we're still on track". Bẫy: Wednesday là hạn báo giá, ten days/three weeks là các mốc khác.
